document.title: Form PENS.C/1 — Expression of Interest to Restore Prior Contributory Service

chunks.part: Form PENS.C/1 — Expression of Interest to Restore Prior Contributory Service
chunks.heading: What form PENS.C/1 is used for
chunks.text: Form PENS.C/1 expresses interest in restoring the participant's most recent period of prior contributory service under article 24. It is time-sensitive: failure to submit within one year of re-entry into the Fund forfeits the right to restore.

chunks.part: Form PENS.C/1 — Expression of Interest to Restore Prior Contributory Service
chunks.heading: Sections on form PENS.C/1
chunks.text: Section 1 - Participant information; Section 2 - Most recent period of prior contributory service (single organization, start date, end date); Section 3 - Acknowledgement and signature.

chunks.part: Form PENS.C/1 — Expression of Interest to Restore Prior Contributory Service
chunks.heading: Acknowledgements made when signing form PENS.C/1
chunks.text: The participant confirms interest in restoring the most recent period of prior contributory service, confirms having read article 24, section F of the Administrative Rules, and the form's instructions, and requests an estimate of the amount payable.
